subject: Sales→CS docking: QuantaHealth implementation kickoff & owner assignment
message_1_headers:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@quantahealth.com>, Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@quantahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QuantaHealth - handoff: implementation context and timing
message_1_body:
Team —

Quick handoff: QuantaHealth signed yesterday (deal RW-2028-8953). They committed to Redwood Dedicated with a pilot of 3 GPUs, two regions (us-west/us-east), and a 6-month evaluation window. Procurement will circulate the final SOW, but I attached the current SOW draft and network topology they provided.

Why this matters: QuantaHealth is our first mid-market payer customer in the West coast cluster; they care a lot about predictable latency and audit logs. Their top priorities for the first 30 days:
- Secure private VPC connection and KMS integration
- Token-level tracing enabled for the pilot routes
- Warm-up plan for prefix caching to keep P95 < 450ms

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Tessa — can you lead the customer kick-off and own the onboarding backlog? Proposed internal kickoff window: Tue 2028-06-06 at 10:00 PT.
2) Monica — please own SSO/SCIM and attest to our audit-scope checklist. QuantaHealth requires SOC2 evidence and KMS flow diagrams by 6/10.
3) Ben — engineering contact for runtime tweaks; they may request a quantized variant if cost SLOs are off.

Attachments: QuantaHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), quanta_network_topology.xlsx (customer-provided).

Lina / Ethan — looping you in so CS can coordinate scheduling and technical contacts. Lina: who from your side should we add to the kickoff for networking (VPC peering) and your security reviewer?

Thanks — more context below (summary of discovery threads).

— Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
